customize.name: Refined Heart
customize.desc:
Specialized refinement material for "Rainbow Serpent's Rain Bow."
A brightly colored, exquisitely crafted finger guard long worn by archers.
The accuracy of an arrow hinges on the archer's experience: The more one draws the bowstring with focused breath, the more seamlessly bow and arrow move in unison. To nock and draw is to temper the spirit. The wear on the guard reflects the sharpness of the archer's resolve.

materials.name: Night-Wind's Mystic Consideration
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
In ancient times, shamans, priests, or those known as mystics were always on the hunt for methods by which they could communicate with the silent underground realm. Ever since the Wayob gradually began to manifest, reacting to the resonance between the lone hero and the Nightsouls, this had been so.
Entrancement, disembodiment, and theurgy were the main methods they chose, each accomplished through the aid of meticulously polished ritual tools.

materials.name: Refractive Bud
materials.desc:
A leaf bud dropped by the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.
It is said that when this creature emerged from the Black Tide, the first things it grew were these tender buds capable of deflecting elemental power.

materials.name: Tattered Warrant
materials.desc:
A warrant issued to members of the Fatui Oprichniki.
One wonders what resolve drove its bearer to sign up.

materials.name: Mora
materials.desc: Common currency. The one language everybody speaks.

materials.name: Night-Wind's Mystic Premonition
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Ancient psychics believed that the Wayob, as formless entities of consciousness, were beings stripped of externality and thus the closest thing to the essence of the spirit.
The process of polishing rough stones until all texture had been removed, turning them into mirrors of pure light, was also seen as a ritual for removing the surface representations of worldly phenomena. Perhaps the reflections that these psychics saw upon the smooth surface of the mirrors were projections of their own spirits...

materials.name: Bewildering Broadleaf
materials.desc:
An arrow-shaped leaf dropped by the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.
After corroding the Ley Lines and extracting the memories within, the creature grows these leaves as a means of storing the information it has deciphered. There may be a close link between these intricately patterned leaves and the forms that their host can mimic.

materials.name: Immaculate Warrant
materials.desc:
A warrant issued to members of the Fatui Oprichniki.
One wonders if the exquisite styling might hide a price paid for its owner's promotion.

materials.name: Night-Wind's Mystic Augury
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
When intangible spirits attach themselves to objects, they merge and transform into various forms through a process known as spiritual fusion. Once this has taken place, these spirits are capable of conveying dreamlike visions to humans in a state of trance.
It fell upon those who frequently engaged in such dialogues with the spirits to interpret these vision-like dreams, translating omens from beneath the earth into language that could be understood by the tribe, or transforming their warnings into stories. It is said that this is the origin of the tribal storytellers, and also why most outstanding storytellers hail from the Night-Wind.

materials.name: Illusory Leafcoil
materials.desc:
A core formed from tightly coiled leaves, the remnant of the monster known as the Tenebrous Mimiflora after being vanquished.
It may appear lifeless and dull on the surface, yet a faint, ominous power can still be sensed pulsing within.
People often wonder where the memories that such creatures drew from the earth go when they are slain. Perhaps the answer lies within this core...

materials.name: Frost-Etched Warrant
materials.desc:
A warrant issued to members of the Fatui Oprichniki.
Adorned by a frost-colored crystal — a symbol of glory. One wonders what deeds its bearer must have performed to prove their loyalty and worth.

materials.name: Night-Wind's Mystic Revelation
materials.desc:
Weapon Ascension Material.
Regardless of how they are polished, representations of worldly matter cannot be made to transcend their physical nature — they will always remain material in essence. Similarly, pure human spirit can neither be expressed solely through the "tree" of intention, nor embodied through obsidian mirrors that need constant polishing. As the power of the Night Kingdom and the Nightsouls grew, so too did the types of objects that could be used for spiritual fusion. Eventually, the Wayob came to be capable of conveying revelations of the Night Kingdom through various thoughts alone, dispensing of the need for devotees to perform the ritual of polishing stones into mirrors. Thus were such ritual tools rendered obsolete.

desc.text:
The decaying Cinder City and the usurper's delirious dream collapsed together into a blaze as brilliant as the sun.
The scarlet-eyed hero summoned the god's fiery wrath, burning the blighted, corrupted throne to drifting ash.
Decades have passed since Maghan the dragon slayer drove the old ruler from the deep valleys.
In the villages that once worshiped the dragons, new generations have long since forgotten their ancestral oaths.
Thus, when the young priest Wagadu fulfilled Maghan's final wish...
And laid him to rest in a nameless grave, taking up his bow, and setting forth toward the mist-shrouded mountains...
He had no understanding of what the old man's dying words truly meant.
What was it to "renew the covenant"? What was it to "restore peace"? Wagadu had no idea.
He simply believed the old priest had asked him to return his cherished bow to the perilous Night Realm...
To soothe the wrathful spirits long abandoned since the age of ancient sacrifice.
He parted the veil of mist and climbed the threefold stone stair.
At the ineffable border of the shadowed realm, a vast, labyrinthine hall revealed itself. Its intricate corridors glowed softly in the flowing light.
Before the young priest could discern whose hand had inscribed the gilded runes, a sudden surge of fog clouded his sight.
Visions rose in the mist and filled his mind.
In a daze, countless shifting forms shimmered like iridescent light.
He saw a maiden with eyes of turquoise, a colossal serpent draped in starlight, and a white spider weaving the sun and moon...
He saw figures of black gold and white steel, a sly hare mocking a wild fox, and a coyote struggling in tar.
Terrified, Wagadu fell to his knees. He begged the sacred ones of the Night Realm to forgive his intrusion.
But when the mist finally lifted, the being that loomed above the hall and gazed down upon him was not the dead he had imagined.
It was a mighty dragon, its wings unfurled like a rainbow cascading across the heavens.
"O soulless one, whose fate is bound to the stars, do not let my form fill you with fear."
"I have long comprehended your purpose, even if your own heart remains veiled in ignorant mist."
"The priest who named himself dragon slayer sent you to forge a covenant for the ages to come."
"The noble blood of the ancients never stained his blade, and that sincerity speaks louder than a thousand words."
"It matters not. Our king has long perished, and I have grown weary of tending to my kin who dwell within dreams."
"I am willing to impart all the secret rites I know, that your tribes may prosper."
"To let you hear the whispers of the night without giving blood to the envoy who has fallen into the underworld."
"For this, I ask but two things in return, as price for the covenant to be sealed."
"First, your descendants must treat the ancient people I once protected as friends and equals."
"They must heed their counsel at all times, and never allow their oaths to become mockery like the Grand Alliance."
"Second, your descendants must strike my name from every woven record and scroll."
"Let no self-proclaimed sage uncover it, lest they bring ruin upon our pact through their foolish revenge."
"You need not consider, only accept. The Wayob that shelters you was once my servant."
"Long before your birth, she told me of this transgressive covenant."
Like one just awakening, unable to tell dream from reality, the dazed Wagadu nodded to signify acceptance.
In an instant, the gilded hall and the mighty dragon dissolved like mist from a past age.
Wagadu was still wondering whether the visions he had just witnessed were anything more than a fleeting dream born of fatigue...
When suddenly, he felt a soft, feather-like touch at his side, cold as the night wind, that made him instinctively turn around.
There, according to legend, stood the first Iktomisaurus, newly emerged from the Night Kingdom.
